verdict.rationale: All evidence describes merchant-side infrastructure (Agent Ready, Store Sync, agent toolkit, cart APIs) that lets AI agents check out with merchants or lets merchants build agents for order/refund/dispute management — none of it describes a consumer-provisioned wallet that a user funds, an agent holds/spends from, with balance visibility. The delegated tokens in ACP/UCP are single-use, merchant-bound checkout credentials, not a persistent user wallet.
